message:
feat(territory): make editing atomic and rotation-aware

Refuse mixed locked/read-only selections atomically, clear canonical Governor
assignments on duplicate, rotate complete selected groups around an explicit
selection pivot, and use rotated footprint/coverage geometry consistently for
hit testing, box selection, drawing and overlays.

Focused evidence: 18 command/session/scene Node tests pass; vue-tsc and scoped
ESLint pass. Recovery UI and broader T05/T06 browser evidence remain open; PR stays draft.
